title: recordedPreview
responsibility: Reads a precisely bound, hash-checked runtime thumbnail for the selected project and revision.

inputs.name: workspace
inputs.description: The selected project and commit, and its evidence connection.

inputs.name: entityId
inputs.description: The exact page or component whose screenshot is requested.

inputs.name: thumbnail
inputs.description: A recorded state binding; it never requests a planning design.

inputs.name: apply
inputs.description: Receives loading, ready, missing or error, including the checked image URL and its original tested revision.

outputs.name: stop
outputs.description: Cancels display of late results and releases the image URL. Failures are reported through apply.
